archetypes.name: dyn-shell-compat
archetypes.rationale: for loop glob expansion in marker_candidates must work correctly in bash 3.2 and handle unmatched glob patterns safely
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new for-loop glob expansion in marker_candidates() in hook-no-progress-guard.sh and hook-bg-poll-guard.sh. Verify it handles the case where no larch-* or claude-design-* dirs exist (glob returns literal pattern). Check that [ -d ] guard is correct. Verify maxdepth 2 inner find covers the same depth as the old maxdepth 3 from TMPDIR root for any markers one level inside session dirs. Confirm Bash 3.2 compatibility. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
